copy.tagline: 复用模板变量和结构规则来编写提示词
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为项目建立统一的提示词编写规范
copy.tagline_en: Reuse template variables and structural rules to write prompts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to establish consistent prompt engineering conventions for your project

howto.what: Claude 会按照模板变量和结构规则组装提示词，避免重复编写。它使用占位符（如 <PLACEHOLDER>）来插入运行时数据，并强制执行安全规则（如必须使用发送命令）。
howto.when: 当 Claude 需要为 x-cmd 模块（如 claw）生成或处理提示词时触发，例如在首次联系、心跳检测或跨平台消息处理场景中。

say.text: 用模板变量生成一个 Telegram 消息提示词。
为 WeChat 写一个带安全规则的提示词。

howto.what_en: Claude assembles prompts from reusable fragments using template variables and structure rules, avoiding duplication. It uses <PLACEHOLDER> for runtime data and enforces safety rules like mandatory send commands.
howto.when_en: Triggered when Claude needs to generate or process prompts for x-cmd modules (e.g., claw), such as first contact, heartbeat, or cross-platform message handling.

say_en.text: Generate a Telegram message prompt using template variables.
Write a WeChat prompt with safety rules.
